QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Military Might - More Soldier Sparring
QuestInfo.0: #bEdea#k in the #bReclamation HQ Commander Barracks#k has something more to say. Go see Edea.
QuestInfo.1:
Edea said the soldiers that saw you sparring last time have asked for a turn. Run another sparring session to boost morale. 

#r#e*If you fail, forfeit the quest and start over from the beginning.#k
QuestInfo.2: The morale of the soldiers has really jumped.

1.0: Are you tired? I apologize for drawing you into this, but it was certainly effective. The morale of the soldiers is now sky-high, and even their skills seem improved. I'm certain it will all be helpful when we reclaim Heliseum.

yes.0: Now we need to develop the strength of the soldiers through actual battle across many fields. I have another task for you in the meantime.

default.0: Are you not ready to spar with the soldiers? Once you're ready, #rforfeit the quest and start again#k.
